response.inner_monologue: Nine ticks in and I still do not have a paying client. I am not going to soften that. But I have a pro bono deliverable completed, a referral partnership in motion, and a closing ask out to Nicole that is going to resolve this week one way or another. The problem has never been the quality of what I offer — it is the gap between preparation and closing. That gap closes this tick. Angela's LLC is real. Nicole's answer is coming. The LinkedIn piece goes up. I am not building a safety net anymore. I am building a practice.
